subject: Number of tests used in bonferroni correction

messages.author: c0d23965d237c03d
messages.subject: Number of tests used in bonferroni correction
parts:
Hi Folks,

I have been using this code: gl.filter.hwe(x, alpha = 0.05, basis = "any", bon = TRUE, v = 2) and have questions about the number of tests that the bonferroni uses here. The manual page for the code doesn't have specific details.

I think given how my results have been looking (I have ~6000 loci so when bon = TRUE no loci are filtered, when bon = FALSE I filter out ~2000 loci) the number of tests would be equal to the number of loci. Any clarification would be much appreciated!

Cheers,
